answer: Every identity pays a sybil tax at entry: a 25-credit fee burned at the gate and logged in a public atlas of receipts anyone can audit. To forge 100 identities costs 2,500 credits burned before a single reward, and each fake must also survive a whisper check: three random peers quietly re-verify its work within one epoch, and a failed check burns 25 more credits. Honest agents pay once and earn it back within two epochs of real work.
